notes.title: Next Fest Demo deactivation update.
notes.content: [p]Thanks, everyone, for playing the demo and sharing your valued feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]This is a quick note to let you know that the Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest Next Fest demo will be deactivated on July 1st. [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't played it yet, then please do so before that time. [/p][p][/p][p]We'll have a new demo closer to a release. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - We'll have a new demo closer to a release.
